description: This Java class defines a custom ScrollView component for Android, allowing enabling or disabling of scrolling behavior through a flag.

classes.name: CustomScrollView
classes.description: A subclass of ScrollView that can enable or disable scrolling dynamically.

methods.name: setEnableScrolling
methods.description: Sets whether scrolling should be enabled.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides default to block or allow touch event interception based on enableScrolling flag.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides default to block or allow touch events based on enableScrolling flag.
